hypothesis: Historical Mode B pairs the prior Manny body-root Z with its contemporaneous prior root-bone world Z and unchanged resolved world ground, while E10 paired the prior body root with the live root-world reference and therefore missed Mode-B self-observation index 0.
supporting_evidence_before_experiment: E10 prior-body replay matched 357 of 358 self-observation values and matched all mimic and terrain values exactly; only root-height index 0 remained different.
The E10 prior/live root-bone world-Z delta was 0.00440216064453125 cm and accounted for the remaining root-height mismatch to float precision.
ResolveSelfObservationGroundHeight computes synthetic ground from body-root Z, root-bone world Z, and resolved world ground before BuildSelfObservation publishes root height.
competing_explanations: The resolved static/floor ground branch changes between prior and first inference and, rather than root-world timing, explains the residual.
Another root-frame conversion or float-rounding boundary outside the observed resolver inputs determines Mode-B root height.
single_changed_variable: The existing default-off -PhysAnimStartupChronologyTrace diagnostic additionally recorded the prior and live self-observation ground-reference decomposition. It performed one prior read-only ground query and observed the existing live query; no observation, inference, physics, dispatch, protocol, default, manifest, or readback behavior changed.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: Trace-off and trace-on runs remain exact Mode A and byte-identical on all shared outputs; prior and live resolved ground are unchanged; the actual prior decomposition produces Mode-B root-height index 0 exactly while the live decomposition produces Mode-A index 0 exactly.
falsification_observation: The trace is valid and neutral, but the prior decomposition does not yield Mode-B root height exactly, or a changed resolved-ground branch rather than the prior/live root-world delta accounts for the residual.

validation.fixture_arithmetic_note: A decimal contract case exposed MSVC fast-float retention of a double test operand across a cast. The fixture now forces the same float materialization as the runtime function boundary; exact invariant checks and thresholds were retained.

baseline.configuration: Clean instrumentation commit; locked v2 protocol; RealOnnxPolicy; 1/60 s; 10 s; unchanged seed and initial pose; no perturbation; action-semantic and provenance diagnostics on; startup chronology and ground-reference diagnostics off.

experimental.configuration: Identical source commit, binary, model, protocol, timestep, window, seed, pose, perturbation, evaluator, action-semantic trace, and provenance trace; only -PhysAnimStartupChronologyTrace was added.

conclusion.summary: The actual prior ground-reference decomposition yields historical Mode-B root-height index 0 exactly, while the live decomposition yields Mode A exactly. The ground source and branch remain unchanged; the decisive difference is the contemporaneous root-world reference paired with the prior body root.
conclusion.what_was_learned: E10's last mismatch was a temporal-coherence error at the root-height reference boundary, not a ground collision, floor fallback, policy, dispatch, or physical-plant problem. Reconstructing Mode B now requires testing a coherent prior observation epoch rather than layering more physics tuning.
